info.name: TOPdesk
info.summary: See your own TOPdesk tickets on your Nextcloud dashboard and report a new one without leaving it.
info.description:
Connects Nextcloud to a TOPdesk SaaS environment.
**Dashboard widget** - Your five most recent TOPdesk tickets, newest first, with status and ticket number - A button to report a new ticket from the dashboard, without opening TOPdesk
**Admin settings** - One connection to the customer's TOPdesk SaaS environment, authenticated with either an application token or an OAuth client-credentials connected application - A "Test connection" button that performs a real authenticated call before you save - Credentials are encrypted at rest with Nextcloud's own crypto service
**How a Nextcloud user becomes a TOPdesk person**
The app matches each Nextcloud user to exactly one TOPdesk person card and stores that person's UUID alongside the value it matched on. Tickets are then always read with a filter on that UUID, never on the email address.
That distinction matters because email addresses get reused. When someone leaves and their address is handed to a new colleague, matching on the address alone would show the newcomer the leaver's ticket history. So the pair is re-verified on every login: if the address now resolves to a different TOPdesk person, the app treats that as a new human, replaces the stored UUID and shows only the new person's tickets. If it resolves to nobody, or to more than one person, the app links nothing at all rather than guessing.
